# Shared symbol map for build_image.py: name address [code|ram]
# A file's own `/* 0xADDR */` comments take precedence (some names differ between files).

serial_buf          0x011D ram
ctl_table_stamp     0x017D ram
event_ring_rd       0x017E ram

prog_ticks          0x0190 ram
cfg_car_count       0x01A0 ram
btn_b0_held         0x01B4 ram
btn_c6_held         0x01B5 ram
ta_off_flag         0x020F ram
flag_213            0x0213 ram
sm_state            0x0218 ram
status_byte_219     0x0219 ram
slot_tab            0x021C ram
# code
reply_append_checksum 0x01EA code

# flash data (progmem), code-space addresses
